title: Atlantic hurricane power in 2008-2025 was below a frozen 1946-2007 absolute-SST regression and near a relative-SST regression; neither had year-to-year skill (HURDAT2, ERSSTv5)
abstract: Vecchi, Swanson and Soden (2008) fitted annual Atlantic power dissipation index (PDI) on August-October main development region (MDR) sea surface temperature (SST) for 1946-2007. Absolute and relative SST (MDR minus 30S-30N mean) fitted equally well but gave very different futures. After 2007 the MDR warmed about twice as much as relative SST (+0.66 C against +0.31 C), so 2008-2025 is an out-of-sample test. We fitted both regressions on 1946-2007 with HURDAT2 and ERSSTv5, froze them, and predicted 18 seasons. The observed mean PDI was 3.05 x 10^11 m^3 s^-2. The absolute model predicted 4.15 (95% interval 3.12-5.19, p = 0.018) and was too high in 16 of 18 seasons. The relative model predicted 3.34 (2.67-4.07, p = 0.20). A predictor MDR minus k times tropical mean matched the observed mean at k = 1.11 (ERSSTv5) and 1.03 (HadISST); k below 0.85 (0.65) failed. In 32 variants (SST set, MDR box, PDI/ACE/log PDI, training from 1946 or 1970), the absolute model over-predicted by 18-33% and the relative model by 0.3-19%; with 1970 training the relative model also failed in 12 of 16. Year by year, neither model beat the 1946-2007 mean: the MSE difference had a 95% interval of -0.98 to 2.13. Limits: 18 seasons, one mean level, no pre-1970 intensity correction, possible observing changes and multidecadal variability. Code, annual aggregates, hashes and a retrieval script are included.

display.caption: A: Atlantic PDI 1946-2025 (bars), 5-year running means of observations and of the absolute-SST and relative-SST regressions fitted on 1946-2007 only. Dashed lines give 2008-2025 means: observed 3.05, absolute 4.15, relative 3.34 (10^11 m^3 s^-2). B: August-October ERSSTv5 anomalies (1981-2000 base) of MDR absolute SST, MDR relative SST and the 30S-30N mean.

Predicted 2008-2025 mean PDI (line) and 95% prediction interval (band) from 1946-2007 fits that use MDR SST minus k times tropical-mean SST, for ERSSTv5 and HadISST1. Dashed line: observed mean. k = 0 is the absolute model, k = 1 is the relative model.

Observed 2008-2025 mean relative to the frozen prediction (%) for the absolute (blue) and relative (orange) models in 32 variants: SST set, MDR box (vss08 = 70W-20W 7.5N-22.5N; em05 = 60W-20W 6N-18N), response and training start. Negative values mean the model predicted too much activity.
